LESSON: OBEDIENCE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.3: Obedience

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Obedience
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to obey?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read Exodus 20:12 and state the benefit of honouring parents
2. obey parents and teachers to promote harmonious co- existence
3. practise responsibility by obeying school rules

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

2. Practise: obey parents and teachers to promote harmonious co- existence
